{{Quote|A little trick my parents picked up before I was born. Didn’t you see how Dad noobed Atar?|Jaina Solo|<ref name="Abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref>}}
The '''Sligh Slipper''' was a tactical ruse in which an individual feigned compliance with an opponent while covertly preparing an escape or reversal of control. The maneuver involved giving the impression of obedience, then taking advantage of the opponent’s forward motion or distraction to close off an exit, barrier, or passageway at the last possible moment, leaving the opponent outmaneuvered.<ref name="Abyss" />

[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] once used this tactic on Captain [[Atar]] of the [[Galactic Alliance Security]].<ref name="Abyss" />
